# DataFlowr

> DataFlowr is a boutique Exact Online Premium integration partner and hyperautomation
> consultancy based in the Randstad, the Netherlands. Founded in 2025 by Daan Jansen
> (financial control & consultancy) and Jan-Willem Gmelig Meyling (solution architect &
> software engineer). Primary language: Dutch; English pages under /en.

DataFlowr combines three disciplines in one team: deep Exact Online ecosystem knowledge
(early adopter of the Power BI Connector and Smart Closing), finance process expertise
(closing, invoicing, reconciliation, controls and auditability) and software engineering
(integrations, orchestration, custom portals).

## Product

- [Claire](https://dataflowr.nl/claire): the AI layer on top of Exact Online. Claire answers
  questions about your figures in plain language, prepares the month-end close, watches
  receivables and works autonomously on schedule. Built on MCP (Model Context Protocol),
  so it works in Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot or any MCP client. Reads freely,
  writes only after explicit user approval; no shadow copy of your data. Live within a day.

## Services

All six services are listed at https://dataflowr.nl/diensten (English:
https://dataflowr.nl/en/services).

- [Exact Online Premium](https://dataflowr.nl/diensten/exact-online-premium): implementation,
  migration, Smart Closing, Power BI Connector, multi-entity alignment, governance & controls.
- [Integraties](https://dataflowr.nl/diensten/integraties): API integrations for webshops,
  PSPs (Mollie, Pay.nl, Adyen), CRM and portals, with PSP reconciliation and monitoring.
- [Make & low-code](https://dataflowr.nl/diensten/make): automations in Make and n8n with
  custom Exact Online connectors; teams can read and adapt the flows themselves.
- [Camunda](https://dataflowr.nl/diensten/camunda): workflow orchestration with BPMN and DMN,
  full audit trail per process instance.
- [RPA](https://dataflowr.nl/diensten/rpa): robotic process automation for systems without an
  API; every run identical and logged with screenshots, as a bridge to real integration.
- [Training](https://dataflowr.nl/diensten/training): finance-team enablement on the client's
  own administration: Exact Online Premium, Make and working with AI in the books.

## Legal

- [Privacyverklaring](https://dataflowr.nl/privacyverklaring): what data DataFlowr processes,
  which processors are involved (Auth0, Stripe, OpenRouter, hosting), retention periods, and
  what happens to an Exact Online administration when Claire is used. English at
  https://dataflowr.nl/en/privacy; the published short link https://dataflowr.nl/privacy
  redirects here.
- [Algemene voorwaarden](https://dataflowr.nl/algemene-voorwaarden): terms for consultancy
  engagements and for the Claire subscription, including the customer's own responsibility for
  their books and filings. English at https://dataflowr.nl/en/terms; the published short link
  https://dataflowr.nl/terms redirects here.
- Privacy contact: privacy@dataflowr.nl
